translated_text: One Creator, Truth is His Name, Creative Being, Without Fear, Without Hate, Timeless Form, Unborn, Self-Existent, Known by the Guru's Grace.
original_text: Ik Onkar, Satnam, Karta Purakh, Nirbhau, Nirvair, Akal Murat, Ajuni, Saibhang, Gurprasad.

translated_text: Meditate, the Primal Creator, the Creative Being.
Chant the Name of the True Lord.
Wind is the Guru, Water the Father, Earth the Great Mother.
original_text: Pavan guru pani pita mata dhart mahat.

translated_text: In Dhanasiri — the wind is the Guru.
What is that Gate, what is that place where all sit and become one?
original_text: So dar katha kavan kara jithe sabhai ekai thikai.

translated_text: In the Realm of Dharma, one must earn one's living.
In the Realm of Knowledge, Your limit is not found.
original_text: Gyan khand tera ant na paa-ee-a.

translated_text: In the Realm of Honor, there are great treasures.
In the Realm of Tape, beings are tormented.
In the Realm of Truth, the season of spring comes in its own time.
Night and day the Lord of Truth creates anew. The Lord of Truth sits forever.
original_text: Andin Sachiaar keea naee. Sadaa Sachiaar baithaia.

translated_text: Within His Will, He holds all.
One who does not understand His Will goes astray.
The One Creator of all is He.
By His Will, forms are created; His Will cannot be described.
original_text: Hukmī hovan ākār, hukam na kahīā jāī.

translated_text: First His Will, then it is spoken; when rooted in the source.
original_text: Pehle hukam, phir aakhīai, lai mūlai lagaīai.

translated_text: With your breath, meditate on the One.
original_text: Naal bhave tere saa'naa, tithai saa dhee-aaeeai.

translated_text: Do not be an enemy of ego; the Master gives even to enemies.
original_text: Ha-umai naal vair na kee-ai, dushman sahibaa deea.

translated_text: When the Medicine of Truth is found, then ego begins to be cut away.
original_text: Jā sachai kā ḍarū pāīai, tā ha-umai kaṭīai lāgai.

translated_text: Lust and anger are cut away by the blade; in the Holy Company, the Lord is found.
original_text: Kāma krodh mūh churāīai, thakur sādhsaṅg pāīai.

translated_text: Practicing the Way of Justice, one takes the straight road.
original_text: Raajā dharam dṛiḍhaa kamaīai, so ḍhura lai ṡath na jāī.

translated_text: The tongue tastes the essence of essence, and knows the Creator.
original_text: Jihva ikatā sār sārīai, tisai jānai sirjanhārā.

translated_text: Controlling the mind, evil is removed.
original_text: Manasī jevar raṭīai, pāpā dūra hovai.

translated_text: Without this, you shall never find rest; why do you fear the world?
original_text: Aisee naahee thak na jaī, kihaa ḍar aagai hoī.

translated_text: What was done for Him? Who can know it?
original_text: Ki-a-a kīnai ho-aa ka-u na ja-aī.

translated_text: Nanak, by His Will, impurity is removed.
The Truth is true, and the Lord's justice is true.
With firm resolve, let us walk in His Will.
The True King, the True Justice.
original_text: Sē sach ṡāh sē sachī nī-ai.

translated_text: What pleases Him, that is done.
original_text: Jo tis bẖāvai sō arth kīā.

translated_text: How can we live in the fear of the True One?
Nanak, those who see Him are granted this vision.
How then can we live in fear?
Nanak, that seer is obtained.
How can the Truth be covered?
How can the evil eye be turned away?
Nanak, that seer is obtained.
Nanak, with certainty, let us chant.
That Soul is the Supreme Being, the Creator of creation.
original_text: Sō Ātmā, sō pārbrahm, sō karta kartār.

translated_text: One Creator, Truth is His Name, Creative Being, Without Fear, Without Hate, Timeless Form, Unborn, Self-Existent, Known by the Guru's Grace.
original_text: Ik ōaṅkār sat nām kartā purakh nirbhau nirvair akāl mūrat ajūnī saibhaṅ gur prasād.

translated_text: From the beginning of time, the Creator has been running the play of seasons, birth and death.
original_text: Ādi jugadī chalat karta mausam āv jā.

translated_text: God's Word rules the three worlds.
The Word of the Lord of Kings, the Supreme Being.
The Guru's Word.
The Sohila has been recited in the four quarters.
The holy Word of Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji.
original_text: Sri mukhwāk sri guru nānak jī kī bānī.

translated_text: The Destroyer of sorrow, the Giver of peace, the Sanctuary.
Near to those who love the Lord.
Lotus-eyed, absorbed in the divine consciousness.
You are the Lord of armies, the Protector.
Fearless, pure, I have seen Your form.
You are the Creator, the Sustainer.
Medicine for pain, healing for sorrow.
Whose breath of life touches your head.
original_text: Jā kai sās sir jī lāgai.

translated_text: Within your own home, the state of your mind.
original_text: Nij ghar bẖītir gati man kī.

translated_text: You create and You sustain, O Life of the World.
original_text: Tū karta karta aipai jī lāgai.

translated_text: Pain is the medicine, happiness the disease.
Happiness is the medicine, sorrow the disease.
By deeds, by deeds one comes to fear the Lord.
In devotion, suffering does not afflict.
Blessed is that medicine which removes disease.
original_text: Dhan so ṡālā roghu dā darū.

translated_text: Yogi, the Lord's Name is yours.
Chanting the Name, sins are removed.
Nanak says, the Destroyer of sorrow.
In the sky is the plate, the sun and moon are lamps, the stars are pearls sprinkled.
original_text: Gagan mai thāl rav chand dīpak bane tārā mandal janak mote.

translated_text: In the directions the wind blows, water is in the clouds, and fire lives under the ocean.
original_text: Dikkha me pavan chalo pānī cẖẖatī aganī so otī kẖẖāmai ghat jīvā.

translated_text: Meditate on the Self, who has neither sun nor moon.
original_text: Āpō japahu avār nahī sūraj na chando.

translated_text: There is no fear, no fear at all.
original_text: Nā ḍarī rahau nā ḍarī bhī ḍarī.

translated_text: The Lord Himself is pleased; He plays and creates the game.
You Yourself are the Lord, the True Master, who adorns Himself.
original_text: Tū āpā sāhib sāchnā sāhab āpī siṅgārī.

translated_text: You Yourself create and speak.
The True Guru is the sanctuary, merging us with the Lord.
Nanak, hearing His glory, peace comes to the mind.
original_text: Nānak jasu sunī sahaj man āvai.

translated_text: The Aarti (worship) of the Lord by His devotees.
The three worlds sing of the Lord's sweet play.
original_text: Tīn lok ṡāl nārāyaṇ rasal līlā.

translated_text: The Aarti of the Lord of the World.
The whole universe is the altar, the sky the lamp, the sun and moon the wicks.
original_text: Sāgal jharoka ārati ākāsa deepam bale.

translated_text: The divine realm, the three worlds, He lifts up.
original_text: Devalok tīn lok dīpaka jā kai sargasi uṭhāiā.

translated_text: You, Lord, are the Savior, the essence of divine play.
original_text: Tū sāhib sāl nārāyaṇ rasal līlā.

translated_text: The divine realm, the three worlds, the Lord's sweet play.
original_text: Devalok tīn lok sāhib rasal līlā.

translated_text: You Yourself light the divine lamp that is raised in heaven.
original_text: Tū āpī devalok dīpak jā kai sargasi uṭhāiā.

translated_text: The Savior, the Lord, the sweet play.
The whole universe is the altar, the sky the lamp.
The Lord Himself is pleased, creating His play.
In all three worlds, the Lord is the Savior, the essence of divine play.
original_text: Tīn lok sāhib sāl nārāyaṇ rasal līlā.

translated_text: You Yourself are the Lord, the Savior, the essence of divine play.
original_text: Āpe sāhib sāl nārāyaṇ rasal līlā.

translated_text: With friends, the Sohila is sung on the easy path.
original_text: Sathī nāl sohilā sahaj pathāṇīkai sāṅg.

translated_text: That day is bright when one meets the Lord.
original_text: Soi din chānā jo sāhib mil jāvai.

translated_text: One who is drowning in dark waters is lifted up.
original_text: Kālā pānī ḍubā sath mīl uṭh jāvai.

translated_text: One truly lives who lives in the fear of the Name.
original_text: Sō jīvai jo nāma ḍar jīvai.

translated_text: The Lord's feet are the sanctuary, the Lord is the sanctuary.
O Lord, this is Your Aarti.
O Master, this is Your Aarti.
The three worlds offer Your Aarti.
That day is bright when the Lord is met.
original_text: Soi din chānā sāhib mil jāvai.

translated_text: The soul rejoices in the Lord's Name.
original_text: Ātmarām jī aṅg sāṅgī har nām rasī.

translated_text: The compassionate Lord is the Sanctuary.
O Giver, this is Your Aarti.
The eight-stanza composition of Bhai Gur Das Ji.
The devotee whose heart is pure.
original_text: Bẖagat bẖāvī jā kai hriday ṡudh.

translated_text: Sixteen qualities of the pure one who sings.
Chanting the True Name with love.
Day and night, singing the Lord's virtues.
original_text: Din rati chānā har gun gāvai.

translated_text: In all three worlds, the Lord's sweet play.
The Lord is my King and my Savior.
Bright is the Lord, the Savior, the essence of divine play.
original_text: Chānā sāhib sāl nārāyaṇ rasal līlā.

translated_text: The Lord Himself is pleased, the sweet play.
The True Guru is the sanctuary, merging us with the Lord.
The compassionate Lord is the Sanctuary.
With friends, the Sohila is sung on the easy path.
original_text: Sathī nāl sohilā sahaj pathāṇīkai sāṅg.

translated_text: The devotee whose heart is pure.

translated_text: The Lord Himself is pleased, the sweet play.
The True Guru is the sanctuary, merging us with the Lord.
The Khalsa belongs to God, Victory belongs to God!
original_text: Waheguru Ji Ka Khalsa, Waheguru Ji Ki Fateh!

translated_text: The Name of God is the ship; those who board it reach the other shore.
original_text: Nānak nām jahāz hai, chadhē so utre kināṛe.
